Minor, and new to this lens: cycle 1 passed the programme line. The joke that someone 'learned English from a parrot' laughs at how a person learned English, which is a language-learner stereotype. Many of the family's diaspora grandparents learned English as an additional language. The plot only needs a parrot at the press. rounds[1].pieces.prog must change with this tap, or the quote won't match.

fix_text: Later, while the Committee clears the Grand Marquee, Vale and the Pronouncer are stacking chairs beside you when one more note slides under the door. A different hand, small and careful, in pencil: 'There were always two of us. — V.' Vale reads it twice. 'That isn't mine.' For the first time all season, the Pronouncer looks surprised.
